question: Rafael Nadal won the Men's 2020 French Open title after beating:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Novak Djokovic.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Rafael Nadal is a professional tennis player from **Spain.**
 
• **Rafael Nadal won the men's 2020 French open title by defeating Novak Djokovic in the final.**
 
• It was his** fourth French Open title in a row.**
 
• He won men's 2020 French open singles continuously in** 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.**
 
• Rafael Nadal has won the most french open titles with 13 titles.
 
• He also won the US Open men's singles in 2019.
